fields.Name: IT94 - Form Contributions
fields.Description: Deterministic (no LLM) coverage for metadata-registered form contributions — a MJ: Entity Form Contributions row pointing at a Type='Widget' Component whose spec declares componentRole='form-panel'. Proves the migration landed whole (every column, both filtered uniqueness indexes, the CHECK constraints); that Create Form Contribution persists a Widget component and a Pending, User-scope row with its contribution key, including the derived related:<entity>:<join> key a keyless related claim resolves to; that a duplicate key is refused with ALREADY_EXISTS rather than decided by row order; that Activate Form Contribution Version promotes the draft and demotes the Active sibling sharing its key, so two Active rows can never hold one key; that the design §16 identity-entity clamp drops a Global contribution on MJ: Users at the read path while leaving the caller's own User-scope row alone; and that the instance kill switch actually rolls back, leaving the engine with no contributions at all. Creates and deletes its own contribution and component rows.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Contribution schema, creation, key derivation, duplicate refusal, version activation, the identity-entity clamp, and the kill switch all behave as specified.
